verdict.rationale: Buzz is a collaboration platform rather than an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe reports an official MCP server documented at docs/MCP_DRIVEN_HOOKS.md, and Buzz ships buzz-dev-mcp, described as an MCP server that gives agents a shell and file editor. However, the documented way to connect agents to Buzz itself is the ACP harness plus CLI, and nothing describes MCP tools exposing Buzz channels, messages or repos. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool surface for Buzz workspace data, setup/connection instructions for MCP clients, auth model for the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: It gives any agent a shell and a file editor.
